title: Acquittance
summary: ACQUIT'TANCE, noun 1. A discharge or release from a debt. 2. The writing, which is evidence of a discharge; a receipt in full, which bars a further demand.

inlines.v: ACQUIT'TANCE, noun 1. A discharge or release from a debt. 2. The writing, which is evidence of a discharge; a receipt in full, which bars a further demand.
